Ramen Champ

← Back to all restaurants
★★★★★ 4.4
📍 San Jose, California📅 2026
Japanese Ramen Japanese Curry Rice Bowl
Tucked away in a corner plaza on Santa Teresa Blvd in South San Jose, Ramen Champ is a cozy Japanese ramen spot that’s open every single day for lunch and dinner. What really makes this place stand out is the incredible variety of broths—you can choose from Tonkotsu (rich pork bone broth), Yuzu Shio (citrusy salt broth), Shoyu (soy sauce), or Miso, all with customizable spice levels and toppings. They also serve up Tsukemen (dipping noodles), Abura Soba (soupless oil noodles), curry rice, and various Donburi (rice bowls), plus they offer easy online ordering for those on the go. The signature Tonkotsu Ramen comes with a creamy, milky broth and thin, straight noodles, topped with Chashu (braised pork belly), wood ear mushrooms, bean sprouts, and Nori. If you’re looking for something lighter, the Yuzu Shio Ramen is the way to go—it’s a refreshing clear broth infused with a bright citrusy aroma, finished with Menma (bamboo shoots), Wakame seaweed, Chashu, and a large sheet of Nori. For a heartier fix, the Tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet) Curry Rice features a freshly fried cutlet that’s super crunchy on the outside and tender on the inside, smothered in a thick curry sauce with pickled red ginger and a side of miso soup. The menu keeps things interesting with Spicy Tonkotsu, Tantanmen (spicy sesame noodles), and even a vegetarian-friendly Yuzu Shio option. You can kick off your meal with appetizers like Karaage (Japanese fried chicken), Gyoza (pan-fried dumplings), Takoyaki (octopus balls), or fried oysters, and definitely save room for dessert—they’ve got Taiyaki (fish-shaped pastry with filling) and lychee ice cream. Perfect for solo diners, family gatherings, and anyone craving an authentic Japanese ramen fix for lunch or dinner.
